title: An object extension's validations are judged at neither the publish door nor os build, yet the registry registers them on the target object
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvfX5bawZKtfa6u7j9

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up the #33072 implementer and its contract review both surfaced (record 6858831273 ③ and delta record 6864935727 on PR #33119); out of that card's scope.
Business reason: a validation rule is an expression every save of the object runs. An extension's `validations` reach the object through the registry with no expression judgment, so a misspelt field or an invalid expression is accepted in Studio and in `os build`. It only fails when an end user saves a record. The object's own validations are judged today.
Reader who acts: the owner of `packages/lint` `validate-expressions.ts` (the extension walk, #32875 / #33072).

## 维护者速读

对象扩展里的 `validations`（校验规则）在发布门和 `os build` 都不判定表达式，但注册表会把它们挂到目标对象上；写错字段或表达式要到最终用户保存记录时才报错。对象自身的校验规则是判定的。

## Expected

The extension walk judges each `validations` entry an extension carries against the object as served, at the build and the `object_extension` door, with the same rule ids the object's own validations get.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open extension validations` checked at filing. Related: #33072, #32875.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
